name: matters-eml-skillset
description: Extracts attachment file names from .eml files via the EmlAttachmentNamesSkill Azure Function (RegExAzFunc app).

skills.name: eml-attachment-names
skills.description: batchSize 1, not 2: file_data is base64, so batching two large messages made a very big POST body and requests exceeded the 230s timeout. Search then dropped the connection - 'Web Api request failed' at the indexer, 'Broken pipe' in the function - failing 345 documents in one run. degreeOfParallelism 3 rather than the default 5, so a large indexing backlog does not put five heavy concurrent requests on 2 GB instances.

skills.name: split-content
skills.description: First chunk only, so each document gets exactly one vector and the index stays one row per email. Chunking per page would make a result a chunk rather than a message, which the web part's paging, counts and de-duplication all assume.

skills.name: embed-content
skills.description: No apiKey: the search service authenticates with its own system-assigned identity, granted Cognitive Services OpenAI User on the account.
